office: D BLK Architects (as seen in the optional-content groups of a 2025 sales-sheet PDF; xref prefix '<floor xref>|' kept)
about: CAD layer name (regex, case-insensitive, first class in 'order' wins) -> semantic class. One map serves the PDF reader (OCG names) and the DXF reader (DXF layer names). Classes: wall_fill (solid hatch of a cut wall/column), wall_line (wall outlines), column, window (glazing / sashes), door (leaves + swings), railing (balcony/terrace edge, a room boundary), slab_edge (slab or beam edge, a room boundary only for outdoor rooms), dimension, text (room labels), furniture, plumbing, ignore. Anything unmatched is 'unmapped' and listed in the report.

style_fallback.why: a PDF without layers: mid-grey solid fill is the cut-wall poche on most Israeli sales sheets
